messages:
Maya (Support): Heads up — AMEX charge for INV-2026-0427 failed, customer says bank returned "missing tax id".
Sam (Billing): Checking gateway. Log snippet:
invoice-bot: ```{"gateway":"stripe","charge_id":"ch_1JZx9A","status":"declined","code":"05","message":"do_not_honor","processor_message":"Missing VAT / tax id","network":"amex"}```
Maya (Support): Vendor is DE-based. They require VAT number on invoices otherwise AMEX rejects charges.
Paul (Accounts): We sometimes see issuer-level declines for EU B2B without VAT. Can you confirm invoice had vat_id?
Sam (Billing): Opened invoice in billing UI — vat_id blank on the sent invoice.
Maya (Support): Customer can provide VAT now: DE123456789. Can we patch and retry capture? They prefer card.
Paul (Accounts): I can patch invoice metadata and trigger a manual retry-capture. Doing it now.
invoice-bot: Retrying capture for INV-2026-0427 with vat_id=DE123456789...
invoice-bot: ```{"attempt":2,"result":"declined","code":"04","message":"card_not_supported_for_merchant","network":"amex","processor_message":"Card not supported for merchant category"}```
Sam (Billing): Different decline code on retry. Looks like issuer or AMEX network blocking this merchant/BIN for subscriptions.
Maya (Support): Customer reports bank message: "merchant blocked for AMEX subscriptions" — they see multiple AMEX declines.
Paul (Accounts): Action items: (1) Verify MCC we send to gateway, (2) escalate to AMEX/gateway with full payload, (3) offer fallback payment (wire/ACH) in the meantime.
Sam (Billing): Gateway payload shows mcc=5734 (computer software) — that's correct. Escalating to payments ops and AMEX. Creating ticket GW-2026-889 with logs.
Maya (Support): I'll offer wire and note escalation. Customer accepted wire temporarily but wants card fixed.
payments-ops: Acknowledged. We see BIN-level/issuer blocks for AMEX in EU for certain merchant profiles. Onboarding team contacting AMEX. ETA 24-48h.
Paul (Accounts): Short-term mitigation: add VAT ID validation to invoice generation for EU companies so we don't send VAT-less invoices by default.
Sam (Billing): Added check to billing backlog and flagged as high priority for this class of declines.
Maya (Support): Marking thread escalated, will follow up to customer once AMEX/gateway responds. Closing interim support loop since customer accepted wire. :thumbsup:
